Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 5, causing a player to mill three cards.

Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.

When Ancestral Statue enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.

Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.

Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Maja triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
